findings.message: 17 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.site-header 248px | div.exp-item.rv 992px | div.exp-item.rv 992px | div.exp-item.rv 992px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 64px (4.4vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 296px from the left edge but only to 173px from the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (296px, 325px, 733px, 659px, 993px, 337px, 675px); the three most used hold only 58% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Only 1 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 2 of 12 desktop screens are almost empty ground (under 20% of the screen holds text, a picture or a colour field): screens 10, 12.
findings.fix: An empty screen is a rest only once per page. Elsewhere it means the section is underbuilt: set its content larger, give it the full information, put it on a colour field, or cut it.
